proposal.reason: Main substantive change is a broad CI/testing pipeline overhaul: dual-platform workflow execution (M890P+810E), trusted HPN SDK URL selection/installation plumbing, expanded case generation/grouping/reconciliation logic, device-allocation mapping in the test executor, and associated CI test/report updates. Documentation and large added case-list JSON files (including patch_omitted files) support this same CI behavior rather than introducing separate production-module policy/protocol ownership changes.
